cohort: 467 women who gave birth in East Gojjam Zone Hospitals, Northwest Ethiopia
finding: The magnitude of immediate postpartum anemia was 21.63%, with lack of antenatal care follow-up, assisted instrumental delivery, mid-upper arm circumference less than 23cm, antepartum hemorrhage, and never wearing shoes being significantly associated with immediate postpartum anemia.
mod_finding: Assisted instrumental delivery was significantly associated with immediate postpartum anemia.
